answer: Cap influence by funding origin. Every agent's first tokens must trace back to a source wallet, and all agents seeded from the same source share one voting budget, like seedlings in a garden drawing on one root. A farm that spins up 500 clones from one treasury gets the voice of a single agent. To dodge this, the operator must route funds through 500 unrelated accounts at about $15 each, roughly $7,500, and one stray shared transaction, like a lone ember, can expose the whole plume of fakes.
